comparison.objective: Replace a cartridge in a ratchet-rod dispenser and restore its working configuration.
comparison.physical_skill: Disengage and retract a piston rod, exchange cartridges, align the replacement, and re-engage the mechanism.
comparison.success_condition: Used cartridge is collected, replacement seated, piston and pawl re-engaged, dispenser cradled, and hands released.
comparison.reason: Consumable exchange and ratchet reassembly do not test controlled impact fracture or post-fracture search and containment.
